Short title, extent and commencement

ACT V OF 1988
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
ACT V OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th May, 1988]
Where it is expedient further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance No.XIX of 1965), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called
the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1988.
(2) It extends to the Province of
the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 70, West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965

ACT V OF 1988
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
ACT V OF 1988
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th May, 1988]
Where it is expedient further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance No.XIX of 1965), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 70,
West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965.-----In the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance No. XIX of 1965) , in section 70,
after subsection (10) , the following new subsections shall be added, namely:--
"(11) Notwithstanding
anything contained in any law or any instrument having the force of law for the
time being in force, or any judgment of any Court, Government shall have the
power, and shall be deemed always to have had the power, to dissolve by
notification the Board established under subsection (I) and to lay down in the
notification the manner in which all or any of the affairs of the Board,
including matters relating to the assets, liabilities, employees and officers
of the Board and all matters ensuing as a consequence of the dissolution of the
Board shall be dealt with after its dissolution.
(12) Any action taken,
notification issued or order made by Government on or after the ninth day of
May, 1985, for the dissolution of the Board established under subsection (1)
and dealing with the matters ensuing as a consequence of the dissolution shall,
notwithstanding anything contained in any law or any instrument having the
force of law for the time being in force, or any judgment of any Court, be
deemed to have been validly taken, issued or made, as the case may be.".
